race.comment: ROCKIN' MIA (1) has been hard to follow lately, running fifth (17.95) last time but prior to that ran very well when placed at Maitland. Key player on best and expected to bounce back. BACON (7) was a winner (17.40) at this track two back but out of the placings last time when 7th there. Has a good record here at this journey. Form from his last run is proving strong. Expected to give a good account. JUNGLE MASTER (4) turned in a better run last time to find a minor placing (17.80) at this track behind Good Odds Cuba in a Grade 5. Settled off speed and worked to the line nicely. Winning chance. FLYING MINTER (2) looks an each-way chance.
